mapper.sql: select p.position_id, p.shop_code, p.goods_code, p.goods_name, p.spec, p.unit, p.ware_code, p.ware_name, p.position, p.create_user, p.create_time, p.update_time from sdsshop.u_m_goods_position p
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_m_goods_position (shop_code, goods_code, goods_name, spec, unit, ware_code, ware_name, position, create_user, create_time, update_time) values (#{shopCode}, #{goodsCode}, #{goodsName}, #{spec}, #{unit}, #{wareCode}, #{wareName}, #{position}, #{createUser}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_m_goods_position set goods_code = #{goodsCode}, goods_name = #{goodsName}, spec = #{spec}, unit = #{unit}, ware_code = #{wareCode}, ware_name = #{wareName}, position = #{position}, update_time = sysdate() where shop_code = #{shopCode} and position_id = #{positionId}
